items.prompt:
In a group discussion, you should speak:
A) all at the same time
B) one at a time

When someone else is talking, you should:
A) listen
B) shout
C) walk away

steps: Listen to others. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Talking in order means we take:
A) turns
B) naps
C) toys

Your group is talking about dogs. To stay on topic, you talk about:
A) dogs
B) your lunch
C) a movie

steps: Stay on topic. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A good listener:
A) interrupts
B) listens quietly
C) talks the whole time

To talk in class, you first:
A) shout out
B) raise your hand
C) run around

steps: Raise your hand. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Why do we take turns talking?
A) So everyone can be heard
B) To be slow
C) To be loud
items.answer: A) So everyone can be heard

steps: Turns let all be heard. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) So everyone can be heard

items.prompt:
Which shows you are listening?
A) Looking at the speaker and staying quiet
B) Talking over them
C) Closing your ears
items.answer: A) Looking at the speaker and staying quiet

steps: Signs of listening. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Looking at the speaker and staying quiet
